build_nccl_communicator: build an NCCL communicator using NCCLLibrary with a unique ID and rank for distributed GPU communication
run_nccl_all_reduce: run an NCCL all-reduce operation across GPUs using NCCLLibrary with send and receive buffers on a CUDA stream
run_nccl_all_gather: run an NCCL all-gather operation across GPUs using NCCLLibrary to collect data from all ranks
test_nccl_data_type_conversion: test the ncclDataTypeEnum.from_torch method to convert PyTorch dtypes to NCCL data type integers
test_nccl_reduction_op_conversion: test the ncclRedOpTypeEnum.from_torch method to convert PyTorch ReduceOps to NCCL reduction operation integers
